Class RmiTransport

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
mesos.client.RmiTransport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, RemoteGameCallback, Transport
public class RmiTransport extends UnicastRemoteObject implements Transport, RemoteGameCallback
RMI implementation of Transport.

This class extends UnicastRemoteObject so that the server can call onServerMessage(ServerMessage) directly as a remote method. Without exporting the object via super(), the server receives a RemoteException on the first push attempt.

Outbound messages are sent via RemoteGameService.sendMessage(ClientMessage, String). Inbound messages arrive on a JVM-managed RMI thread and are forwarded to the listener registered with setOnMessage(Consumer).

      public void setOnMessage(Consumer<ServerMessage> listener)
      Description copied from interface: Transport
      Registers the handler invoked for every ServerMessage received from the server. Must be called before Transport.connect(String, int, String, Supplier, Function).
      Specified by:
      setOnMessage in interface Transport
      Parameters:
      listener - called on the transport's reader thread (TCP) or on the RMI callback thread — implementations must be thread-safe with respect to the view's rendering logic

    • connect

      public void connect(String host, int port, String nick, Supplier<Integer> askNumPlayers, Function<List<TotemColor>, TotemColor> askColor) throws Exception
      Looks up the RemoteGameService in the RMI registry and calls login, passing this as the callback stub.
      Specified by:
      connect in interface Transport
      Parameters:
      host - server hostname or IP address
      port - server port (TCP: 1234 default, RMI: 1099 default)
      nick - player nickname
      askNumPlayers - called only when this client must set the player count; must return a value in [2, 5]
      askColor - called after lobby join with the list of available colors; must return the chosen TotemColor (or null for auto-assign)
      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection or login fails (e.g. NICKNAME_TAKEN)
